name: legal-engine
origin: Written for this repository. Working procedures were adapted from the author's own private skills and rewritten generic: no firm, person or decision of the author is included.

skills.legal-workflow: entry point: router, profile, matters, working norms
skills.legal-workflow-update: profile changes after feedback (only when the user asks)
skills.legal-contracts: core module: draft, audit, Word redline
skills.legal-research: core module: legal question, current-version check of an act
skills.legal-watch: core module: law library, monitoring, contract re-review

network.note: Hosts the monitoring scripts read (GET of public pages, paced). With Firecrawl, only where the user allowed it (the `firecrawl` engine and `legal_watch.py fetch` send only legis.md and monitorul.gov.md pages), the page addresses go to Firecrawl through the user's own logged-in CLI; nothing else is sent.
